incidents.issue: Installed Modal 1.2.6 did not support account image builder 2026.10.
Initial image raised NameError: cueq_torch not defined.
incidents.resolution: Installed the native bioemu2[cuda12] extra; successful reruns retain the same frozen cases.

incidents.issue: Confidence exporter called .cpu() on float PTM/iPTM.
incidents.resolution: Wrap scalar confidences with torch.as_tensor; reran without changing molecular inputs.

incidents.issue: Missing checkpoint; pytest-recording/pytest-vcr conflict; frozen MSA keys absent from alignment order/max counts.
incidents.resolution: Native setup_openfold checkpoint/CCD setup; removed pytest-vcr; explicit aln_order/max_seq_counts and no MSA pairing. Ubiquitin native integration preflight and target query succeeded.
Pinned atomworks[ml]==3.0.1; reran unchanged molecular inputs.

incidents.issue: Build lacked Cython, then attempted unavailable clang.
incidents.resolution: Added Cython/SciPy/scikit-learn build dependencies and CC=gcc/CXX=g++; kept v1 checkpoint.

incidents.issue: A100 cannot use the requested FP8 GEMM path; flash attention unavailable.
incidents.resolution: Native upcast-matmul fallback; no failure or substitution of the checkpoint.
